title: K4 answer record
description: One answered question from a Track B run (specification §4.5, K4, B to C). Chunk IDs are in whichever K1 format the run read: version 0 (`<doc_id>#c<nnnn>`) or version 1 (`f<hex>:s<n>:c<n>`, D-54). Version 0.2 is written for coordinator runs (specification §8.1): it adds the lanes, the mode and the kind of question, and a framing model. Version 0.3 is written for a question the reasoning lane answered (specification §8.6): it adds the `reasoning` object, and only version 0.3 may carry it. Written by `python -m graphrag.k4`, one JSON object per line.

run.description: The result file name under graphrag/results/

status.description: not_found_in_graph: exact mode, and the graphs hold no answer (D-59); ask_which: several problems match a question about causes, and the user is asked which (version 0.3)

value.description: Normalized in code: dates YYYY-MM-DD, numbers without separators

chunk_id.description: Child chunk the answer is verified against; null when no retrieved passage supports it

how.description: How the citation was checked in code (B-C08); event_graph: a chunk holding a source event of a result computed in code (E28)

pipeline.description: The base and retrieval settings of the run

lanes.description: The lanes that gave the evidence, in order (version 0.2; reasoning from version 0.3)

frame_kind.description: The kind of question the framing call gave

reasoning.description: The reasoning lane's answer (version 0.3). Causes are model text; only their citations are checked in code. Nothing here is stored in a graph

problem.description: The problem the answer is about; null when several matched and the user is asked which

candidates.description: Every problem that matched the question

stated.description: Causes a report gives, each with at least one citation that code checked

possible.description: Factors visible in the evidence that no report gives as the cause: possibilities, not findings. Empty in exact mode

possible_hidden.description: Possible causes not shown because the mode was exact

removed.description: Items code dropped because no shown evidence supported any of their citations

from.description: corpus: the fixed list of what these reports cannot hold; model: added by the answer model

missing.description: Kinds of evidence a real judgement needs that the reports do not hold

correct.description: Development scoring against the question set's gold, when it has one

start.description: Start time of the problem's first event

end.description: End time of its last event

npt_code.description: Non-productive code; empty for events the question's keywords named

depth_ft.description: Lowest and highest end measured depth of its events

description.description: Its first event's description, cut to 160 characters

chunks.description: The chunk its first event was read from

chunk_id.description: The passage's chunk, or the chunk the event was read from

how.description: model: the cited evidence holds the quote; by_quote: the quote was found in other shown evidence, and the citation moved there

evidence_id.description: The ID shown to the model: E<n> for an event, P<n> for a passage
